# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 16 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Falls Ill

---

**1** When Adam was nine hundred and thirty years old and his death was approaching, he called all his sons together.

**2** They all came — Seth and the others. He said to them: 'My sons, I am sick and in great pain.'

**3** 'Father, what is this sickness that has come upon you?' his sons asked. Adam said: 'My children, great pain has gripped me.'

**4** Seth said to his father: 'My lord, father — don't you know that God is letting you suffer this sickness for your own benefit? He loves you and wants to refine you.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
